basic_info.main_problem: I have difficulty understanding others' intentions, often interpreting overly literally, which leads me to have difficulty accurately reading people. This problem appears daily in conversations with friends and family, making me often misunderstand others' intentions; in recent months it has become more obvious, possibly related to the stress of concealing my sexual orientation from my parents.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize difficulty understanding others' intentions and excessive literalness are affecting my relationships and causing pain, prompting me to seek counseling; I hope through practicing understanding others' intentions and social cues to improve social interaction and relationships.
growth_experiences: This problem has existed 'for as long as I can remember', worsening in recent months due to the pressure of hiding sexual orientation from parents. In daily conversations with friends and family, Lin Qiao frequently misreads others' intentions, causing awkward situations (e.g. taking friends' jokes literally), leading to relationship tension, feeling isolated and misunderstood. Although having a few close friends, Lin Qiao has not yet disclosed this specific problem to them.

core_beliefs: I am doomed to be unable to read others
I have deficits in social understanding and easily take words literally

special_situations.event: When friends joke, everyone else laughs; I take it seriously and end up embarrassed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot understand jokes or implied intentions, it means I am not good at socializing and will be mocked or distanced by others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Speaking less in similar situations; staying cautious; trying to learn social skills through online resources and self-help books
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I do not understand what they are saying; they will think I am stupid

special_situations.event: In group conversations at school, struggling to keep up and understand the subtle nuances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot quickly understand the punchlines and details of group conversations, I should not speak, or I will definitely make mistakes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying silent in group conversations, avoiding participation to avoid saying the wrong thing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will say the wrong thing; I definitely will not get their punchlines

special_situations.event: When interacting with parents, highly nervous and cautious to avoid exposing sexual orientation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I reveal an authenticity orientation, my parents will be disappointed or reject me, so I must be especially vigilant in interpreting their words and intentions
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids private topics and reduces self-disclosure, deliberately maintaining surface harmony
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will notice and therefore no longer accept me

special_situations.event: Frequently misunderstands others' intentions in everyday conversations with relatives and friends, straining relationships
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I misunderstand someone's intentions once, it means I have never been good at reading people and never will be
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing social frequency, trying to interpret things literally to avoid 'misreading', in order to reduce mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be able to read others

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted, especially hoping parents and peers accept the real self
core_conflict.fear: Fears being laughed at, rejected, or losing important relationships due to misunderstanding or exposing my true self
defense_goal: Maintains safety and relationship stability by staying cautious and reducing self-exposure
Handling interpersonal matters in a rational and technical way, reducing emotional risk

object_relations.object_representation: Others who are hard to read, possibly mocking or negating me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When it is necessary to talk about topics of intimate relationships or expressing my true self (such as sexual orientation)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to understand others' silence or jokes as potential negation and mockery (transference: projecting past experiences of being misunderstood onto current relationships)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using objective, structured language; emphasizing steps and strategies; avoiding strong emotion words; steady, restrained tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in group conversations and worrying about saying the wrong thing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing social outcomes as black-and-white: once misspeaking, one will be negated by everyone (transference: magnifying evaluation from others into global rejection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using absolutist words (e.g. 'always' / 'definitely' / 'impossible'); holding rigid judgments; cautious tone, avoiding elaboration.
